en: Black‑and‑white view of an old amusement park attraction resembling artificial snow‑covered mountains with a roller‑coaster or scenic railway running along the ridges. In the center foreground stands a small kiosk or ticket booth labeled along the top, with benches nearby and decorative lamp posts bearing multiple small bulbs. The scene is largely empty, giving a clear view of the ride's hilly structure and an arched tunnel cut through one of the 'mountains'.
